title: Kaizen inbox message
description: One file per user prompt under ~/.claude/.kaizen/inbox/<ts>-<n>.json (v1.22.0+ path; previously ~/.claude/kaizen-inbox/). Producer: inbox.py capture (called by hooks/userprompt-inbox.sh). Consumer: inbox.py {list,peek,drain,stats}. Surfaces pending messages on the next PostToolUse boundary as additionalContext.

ts.description: ISO UTC timestamp with millisecond precision — when the user submitted this prompt.

session_id.description: Claude Code session uuid this message was sent in.

drained.description: Has this message been surfaced to Claude via the PostToolUse drain yet?

drained_at.description: When the drain happened (ISO UTC). Null until drained.

drain_reason.description: Why the drain fired — typically 'turn-starter-completed' or empty if not drained.
